meaning: Using your phone's camera to take a photo of a paper check. The money goes into your bank account without a trip to the bank.
clues: It uses the camera on your phone.
It involves a piece of paper from someone who owes you money.
You take a picture of the front and the back, using your bank's app.
You do not have to visit the bank or an ATM.
It has three words. They start with M, C, and D.
assumes: Direct deposit sends pay straight into an account with no paper
A wire transfer sends money between banks

decoys.meaning: Your pay or benefits go straight into your bank account by computer, with no paper check.
A way to send money from one bank account to another, often to a faraway place.
A card you load with money ahead of time. You can spend only what you loaded.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Back in my day, you stood in line at the bank with a paper check. I made good friends in that line.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Now you can snap the front and back in your bank's app. Keep the paper check until the money clears, just in case.

sources.name: FDIC, Banking at the Speed of Technology
CFPB, How long can a bank or credit union hold funds I deposited?

blank.sentence: I took a photo of a paper check with my phone camera and used ___ to put it in my account.

why: It lets you deposit a check without a trip to the bank.
short: Deposit a check with phone photo
